title: Kissed Roast Malaysian Hake Roast
description: A briny and fluffy Malaysian dish featuring hake, perfect for a crowd, with a macrobiotic-friendly twist. This recipe combines the freshness of the sea with the warmth of roasted spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together grated ginger, minced garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, black pepper, and sea salt.
Place the hake fillets in a shallow baking dish and brush the ginger-garlic mixture evenly over both sides of the fish.
Drizzle coconut oil over the fish, making sure they are well coated.
Roast the hake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the oven and sprinkle chopped cilantro over the top of each fillet.
Serve the hake hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Offer steamed vegetables or roasted sweet potatoes on the side for a well-rounded meal.
